items.prompt: Which test does NOT test anything?
items.explanation: Comparing a value with itself always passes, even if the function is wrong.

items.prompt: A new average function was only tested with [10, 20]. Which extra test matters most?
items.explanation: An empty list is an edge case that often crashes with a division by zero.

items.prompt: After fixing a bug, why does a developer add a new test for that bug?
choices: So the number of tests looks bigger
So the team finds out quickly if the same bug comes back
items.explanation: A regression test fails if the old bug returns, so the team knows right away.

items.prompt: Put the steps for fixing a bug with the help of tests in order.
steps: Write a small test that reproduces the bug (it fails)
Run all tests until they pass
Send a pull request together with the new test
items.explanation: A failing test first proves the bug is real, and the same test proves the fix works.
